name: inventory
command: uname -a; id; cat /proc/self/status | grep -E 'Cap|NoNew'; ip -brief addr; cat /proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces; zcat /proc/config.gz | grep -E 'CONFIG_(OVERLAY|USER_NS|NAMESPACES|CGROUP|VSOCKETS)' ; mount; buildctl debug workers; cat /tmp/buildkitd.log; ls -l /usr/local/bin/buildkit*

name: scratch
command: set -eu; mkdir -p /tmp/context; cp /bin/busybox /tmp/context/busybox; printf '%s\n' 'FROM scratch' 'COPY busybox /bin/busybox' 'RUN ["/bin/busybox", "sh", "-c", "echo BUILD_RUN; /bin/busybox id; /bin/busybox cat /proc/self/status; /bin/busybox echo proof > /proof"]' 'LABEL trial.phase="6"' > /tmp/context/Dockerfile; buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/tmp/context --local dockerfile=/tmp/context --output type=oci,dest=/tmp/scratch.tar
